sources.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent pixel-art NPC chore animation atlas. Two exact approved character identities from input images: Image1 botanist-frog (olive frog in cloak); Image2 conductor-cat (brown cat in gold-trim dark conductor uniform). Preserve each exact species, face, costume, proportions, pixel-art style and right-facing side camera. Temporarily replace carried equipment with the chore tool. Layout exactly FOUR COLUMNS by SIX ROWS, 24 full-body separate sprites with generous transparent margin per cell. No labels/grid/scenery/shadows. Consistent character scale and foot baseline within each row. Every frame differs through real arm articulation. Rows1-3 ONLY frog; rows4-6 ONLY cat. Rows1 and4 SWEEP: four phases ready, push broom forward, long sweeping follow-through, draw broom back. Both hands hold wooden straw broom, feet planted. Rows2 and5 CARRY LOAD/UNLOAD: feet PLANTED, bend to lift small wooden crate, raise crate to waist, hold crate in both hands, lower crate. Do NOT depict walking in these rows. Rows3 and6 TEND: four hand poses lift tin cup, wipe with cloth, rotate cup, lower cup. All figures right-facing. No identity mixing, no extras, no clipped tools/ears/tails. Genuinely transparent alpha, no colored outline fringe or painted background.
